reviews.text: Wonderful place to leave your cats, a fantastic terrace, lots of toys of all kinds, even a deck chair for sunbathing. Alessia, the owner, is very kind and above all very affectionate with the cats. I recommend it, cats treated like princes.
Excellent for my cat, modern and super-equipped facility, managed by competent staff!
Thinking like a cat because they're the ones who have to be there...WONDERFUL!!!
Mayo and Sofia had a wonderful vacation. Little by little, Auntie Alessia won their hearts. Thank you so much for everything!

Absolutely perfect experience. I left my Nuru for 6 months and she was adored every day. The girls are super kind, they think of everything and offer a perfect service. Having the cat limousine service was super convenient; it saved me a lot of time.
Every day I received photos and videos of Nuru and my little girl seemed super happy and at ease.
I'll leave her again sometimes and I'm so happy!!!

It was my kitten Tigger's first experience, and all I can say is, try it and believe it! The girls are excellent, and I had a wonderful five-day experience knowing my little one was in good hands. Highly recommended!
We always leave our Perla here during the summer holidays. Maximum care, cleanliness, and attention to our furry guests.
Highly recommended!

The Cat Suite Hotel won me over: my cat had a wonderful time, the staff are knowledgeable and attentive, and the place is perfectly organized. The only downside is that unfortunately there's not always room during holidays, but that's perfectly understandable.

We've been taking our cat to the Cat Suite Hotel since he was a baby! Alessia and Noemi are two wonderful women who put love and dedication into what they do! We're just as happy as he is to visit them! ❤️
Thanks Roberto! See you on your next kitty vacation, meow🐾 …
Beautiful place, the girls are super good and sweet, my cats are very happy and receive lots of cuddles and love from them ❤️❤️

We've been entrusting our girls to the loving care of Alessia and Naomi for seven years now; for Josie and Ellie, the Cat Suite Hotel has become a go-to destination for their vacations.
The facility is completely safe and feline-friendly!! Each guest has their own space, and their settling-in times are fully respected.
Updates are sent almost daily, and any issues are promptly notified and resolved.
We couldn't ask for anything better!! ❤️❤️

We've been entrusting our Nina to the girls at the Cat Suite Hotel for four years when we go away. It's a vacation for Nina! She has so much fun on the terrace (everything is completely safe for the cats). The girls, Alessia and Noemi, are excellent and always keep us updated on how she's doing. It's become a second home for Nina! I would recommend the Cat Suite Hotel to everyone! 💖

As a mommy, I find it very hard to leave our princess behind.
The girls are delightful and always work in the cats' best interests, building a solid bond of trust. Our little Yumi makes progress in socialization with every vacation, and we are finally happy to entrust her to us!
Our Chanel has been coming here on vacation for years now, it's become her second home with her beloved aunts. She's doing great and we're super relaxed. ❤️
Much more than a cat hotel. They feel at home here. Alessia and the girls are excellent, 100% professional, and incredibly friendly. They treat the cats as if they were their own.
I brought our crazy cat Zenzero for the first time and I was thrilled with the environment, the kindness and the availability. He had a great time and made a beautiful friendship with Lion 😻 …

I left Mochi for 10 days, and I'm very satisfied. The cat was happy, and both owners were kind, patient, and super sweet.
I'll definitely come back to them if I need anything.
They're great!! I highly recommend them.

Our cat Zac (a European shorthair) stayed at the facility for the first time from April 22nd to 27th and had a wonderful time! Luca and his staff are incredibly professional, welcoming, and always ready to share helpful updates. The care they give to the cats is truly exceptional; you can tell they love what they do. Meticulous, attentive, and organized in every way: Zac felt at home and we felt at peace. He'll definitely be back in August! A true 5-star hotel for cats. Highly recommended!
We've been using this wonderful cat hotel for years now. Our two Maine Coons love staying here. The girls are super sweet, helpful, and always smiling. I adore them. 10 out of 10 😍 …
Super welcome to my grandmother Nina..... A wonderful playground built just for them!!!!
Thank you so much Roberta from Aunts Alessia and Naomi, meow🐾 …

This isn't my review, but George's. The day I picked him up, he was running all over the loft as if to say, "I'm staying here, dude!" I'm happy with the experience my furry friend had. He played, had new stimuli, and socialized with other cats. From Alessia's reports, he was always happy and active. I can only recommend and endorse the Cat Suite Hotel.

I rarely write reviews, but for the Cat Suit Hotel I have to, because everything comes from the heart. Alessia and Naomi's care for all their feline guests comes from the heart, and my heartfelt thanks! Professionalism, dedication, and love always go hand in hand at the Cat Suit Hotel.

A beautiful place with perfect care for cats, with highly qualified, experienced, and professional staff. Extremely clean and extremely friendly with all types of cats, breeds and non-breeds, shy and not-so-shy.

Five stars aren't enough!

My two cats, Brivido and Atlante, stayed for three weeks at the Cat Suite Hotel in Milan, and I can say without hesitation that it was the best stay possible for them. From the very first moment, the owner was incredibly kind, sweet, thoughtful, and incredibly attentive: a true cat lover, capable of making every four-legged guest feel at home.

The place is meticulously cared for, immaculately clean, and designed to ensure the cats' maximum physical and emotional well-being. Each suite is a small feline paradise, complete with toys, scratching posts, hiding places, and everything they need to feel at ease. The attention to the cats' health and happiness is truly impressive: constant updates, videos, photos, and a level of care rarely found elsewhere.

Brivido and Atlante returned happy, relaxed, and in perfect health. I couldn't have asked for more. Highly recommended for anyone who truly loves their cats and wants to give them the best.

What can I say? I've been taking my kids for years, and when I have to pick them up, they don't want to come back...that says it all. I'm beyond relaxed because it's like they're at home, and Alessia and Naomi are special.
Freddie and Elvis are happy and can't wait to go back to their aunts...

A true luxury hotel for cats who truly feel on vacation in our absence.
Alessia and Naomi are excellent and take incredible care of them all.
Dea immediately had fun and felt at ease, and a big plus is having the terrace (super protected!) for an outdoor space all to themselves.
Highly recommended!! 💕💕
Thanks to the aunts for hosting Memnoch and Luna 🥰 …

The cat suite Hotel is a wonderful place to leave your furry friend 😻 who will be pampered and spoiled in an absolutely fantastic environment 😍 an entire loft on two floors with lots of toys, scratching posts, shelves, kennels, paths, …
Naomi and Alessia couldn't do anything else in life. They were born for this.
Thank you so much Loredana from the Cat Suite Hotel staff, meow🐾 …

Every time we book a vacation for ourselves, whether it's for a few weeks or just a few days, the first thing we do is secure a place at the Cat Suite Hotel for our little Fosco! Leaving with the peace of mind of knowing he's in an …
